title: AlienRTP
description: A configurable random teleport plugin with GUI, significantly similar to DonutSMP's RTP.
body:
# AlienRTP

AlienRTP is a super fast random teleport plugin designed to replicate the RTP style used on DonutSMP.

Players can teleport to a random location in the world using a simple command while the plugin ensures the location is safe. Text is used during teleportation to create a clean and polished experience instead of flooding chat.

## Features

* Random teleport to a safe location
* Avoids unsafe locations like lava or water
* Configurable teleport radius
* Supports multiple worlds
* Lightweight and simple configuration

## Commands

/rtp, /randomteleport OR 
OP or Console: /rtp (player) (world), /randomteleport (player) (world) 

## Permissions

Commands require default permissions or OP to rtp other players.
